evidence.claim: Analyst request asked to review flagged transaction 3660263 on card C01727-K2 and identify what affected cards showing losses without a shared device profile have in common.
Shared origin scan identified recipient email domain sc.rr.com paid by 16 other cards in the 30 days prior to case opening.
Querying email neighbors for domain sc.rr.com revealed 16 connected cards and multiple confirmed fraud closed cases on those cards including CC-3907, CC-2888, and CC-5117.
Card window showed 3 online payments of product code C to recipient domain sc.rr.com on card C01727-K2: 3660261 ($305.41), 3660262 ($366.35), and 3660263 ($295.92), totaling $967.68 in exposure.
Customer C01727 on card C01727-K2 has 5 prior closed cases of confirmed fraud, including CC-4908, CC-1975, CC-1833, CC-1501, and CC-0723.
The flagged transaction 3660263 amount of $295.92 is within the card baseline with prior median amount $107.86 and prior maximum amount $1,419.28 over 121 prior transactions.

case.summary: Verdict is fraud with 0.92 probability under an undocumented pattern involving a coordinated recipient-email mule ring. The episode comprises online transactions 3660261, 3660262, and 3660263 on card C01727-K2 paying sc.rr.com, with total exposure of $967.68. Decisive evidence shows recipient domain sc.rr.com connects 17 cards in 30 days without a shared device profile, alongside 5 prior confirmed fraud cases on card C01727-K2. A block of card C01727-K2 (L1 route) and filing of a report (L2 route) are recommended pending approval.

sar.narrative: This suspicious activity report is filed under internal case ID AC-HHF-006 to document an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern. The activity involves customer C01727, debit card C01727-K2, and 16 connected cards including C00534-K2, C01357-K1, C01507-K1, C01594-K1, C02167-K2, C03060-K1, C04146-K1, C04668-K1, C05610-K1, C06115-K1, C06639-K1, C08384-K1, C10350-K1, C11617-K1, C11743-K2, and C11940-K1. On 2017-01-17 at 15:29, online transaction 3660261 for $305.41 was executed under product code C in billing region 231.0, followed on 2017-01-18 at 19:40 by online transaction 3660262 for $366.35 in billing region 231.0. On 2017-01-28 at 07:59, online transaction 3660263 for $295.92 occurred in billing region 231.0, all three transactions paying recipient email domain sc.rr.com. The shared recipient email domain sc.rr.com connects card C01727-K2 to 16 peer cards active within 30 days of case opening. Prior to the flagged transaction, card C01727-K2 had 121 transactions with a median amount of $107.86 and maximum amount of $1,419.28, making the sudden sequence of online payments to an unverified recipient email domain unusual. A prior suspicious activity report was filed on this card under closed case CC-1975, CC-1833, CC-1501, and OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. Internal case AC-HHF-006 was opened, connected cards were placed on monitoring, and the case was escalated to an analyst; a block of card C01727-K2 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this filing of a report is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval for total suspicious activity of $967.68.
